b: ^en: A stranger. Kvissentali does not see strangers often.
^en: Speak, but briefly. The day is short.

menu: ^Kes siin raamatut peab? %% Who keeps the book here?
^Miks kaev täis aetakse? %% Why fill the well?
^Kas siit on midagi kadunud? %% Has anything gone missing here?
^Mis raud see seal maas on? %% What iron is that on the ground?
^Mis kimp see seal on? %% What is that bundle over there?
^Mis koht see on? %% What is this place?

c-0: ^en: They read it. Read it again.
^See on minu käekiri. Ma ei mäleta, et oleksin selle kirjutanud. Aga nüüd kirjutan.
^en: That is my hand. I do not remember writing it. But I will write it now.
c-1: ^Mina. Talud, kohustused, piirid. Kui midagi ei ole kirjas, ei ole seda olemas.
^en: I do. Farms, obligations, bounds. What is not written does not exist.
c-2: ^Sest käsk on nii. Mõisa kaev teenib, öeldakse. Keda teenib.
^en: Because the order says so. The manor's well will serve, they say. Serve whom.
^Kui keegi aitaks kivid paika tõsta, ei saaks seda enam täita.
^en: If somebody helped set the stones, it could not be filled any more.
c-3: ^Ta keerab seda kaua käes. Siis noogutab.
^en: They turn it over in their hands for a long time. Then nod.
^See panen ma kivi alla. Et keegi teaks.
^en: This I will put under a stone. So that somebody knows.
c-4: ^Vasktükk, nimega. Isa oma. Kadus ühel sügisel ja ei tulnud tagasi.
^en: A piece of copper, with a name. Father's. It vanished one autumn and never came back.
c-5: ^Kellakeel. Kell läks mõisaga. Keel jäi. Meie omad ei tohi seda viia, nii on vana sõna.
^en: A bell clapper. The bell went with the manor. The clapper stayed. Our own may not carry it, so the old word goes.
c-6: ^Pookoksad. Mõisa aednik jättis. Meil ei ole aega ega maad. Võta, kui tahad.
^en: Grafting stock. The manor's gardener left them. We have neither time nor ground. Take them if you like.
c-7: ^Kvissentali. Kõik, mis siin on, seisab millegi vanema peal.
^en: Kvissentali. Everything here stands on something older.

well_choice: ^en: The stones lie in a heap. The digger looks at you.
^Aita kivid paika. %% Help set the stones.

c-0: ^Pool päeva. Käed on marraskil. Ring on kinni.
^en: Half a day. Hands raw. The ring is closed.
